# Shadow Armada — asset manifest

**103 assets.** Generated by `npm run manifest` from the game's own content
lists, so it cannot fall out of step with the twelve ships, twelve cards,
7 visual hooks and 15 sound cues the build actually ships.

| Status | Count | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SOURCED | 30 | A licence-verified asset is in the build. Credit is on the row and in `ASSETS_CREDITS.md`. |
| PROCEDURAL | 29 | Drawn in code, deliberately, and good enough to ship on. |
| STILL NEEDED | 41 | Nothing in the build. **This is the list to generate against.** |

The game is fully playable today: nothing marked STILL NEEDED blocks anything,
and nothing anywhere is a grey box.

**Intended style, for sizing and framing only:** stylised 3D, bold readable
silhouettes, saturated but not neon, slightly exaggerated proportions. Clean
stylisation, naval subject. Not photoreal, not pixel art.

**Two rules that are not stylistic.** Every asset that can appear on the enemy
side must be information-neutral: an unrevealed hull marker cannot hint at
which of the four ships of that length it is. And every board asset must read
correctly at 48px on a phone, because that is the size it will actually be
seen at.

## UI — 13 files

Board tiles, the charge chip, and the chrome around stakes and ranks.

| File | Size | Ratio | Where it appears | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui/wordmark.svg` | 512x160 | 16:5 | main menu, splash | SHADOW ARMADA lockup. Vector, must survive being drawn at 120px wide. |
| `ui/appicon.png` | 1024x1024 | 1:1 | PWA install, browser tab | App mark alone, no wordmark, safe area 10%. |
| `ui/menu-bg.jpg` | 1170x2532 | 9:19.5 | main menu backdrop | Dark sea horizon. Must stay legible under text at 60% opacity overlay. |
| `ui/cell-water.png` | 256x256 | 1:1 | every board cell, both boards | Water tile. Tiles seamlessly on a 6x6 grid; the grid gap is drawn by CSS, not baked in. |
| `ui/cell-hit.png` | 256x256 | 1:1 | a cell where a shot connected | Burning hull plate. Reads as damage at 48px. |
| `ui/cell-miss.png` | 256x256 | 1:1 | a cell where a shot found water | Spent splash. Must be clearly *not* a hit at a glance and in monochrome. |
| `ui/cell-known.png` | 256x256 | 1:1 | a cell Echo exposed as occupied but unhit | Contact marker. Distinct from both hit and miss — this is knowledge, not damage. |
| `ui/charge-chip.png` | 128x128 | 1:1 | behind every charge number on both hands | The charge glyph. This is the most-looked-at object in the game; it has to read at 14px and at 40px. |
| `ui/timer-ring.png` | 256x256 | 1:1 | round timer | Ring that empties over 20 seconds. Needs a distinct last-5-seconds state. |
| `ui/sol-glyph.svg` | 64x64 | 1:1 | every stake, pot and payout figure | SOL mark. Vector. |
| `ui/stake-tier.png` | 256x128 | 2:1 | arena stake selector, four tiers | Tier plate. One asset, tinted per tier in CSS — not four files. |
| `ui/rank-badge.png` | 256x256 | 1:1 | leaderboard rows, season screen | Rank frame. Tinted per payout band; the badge itself is one asset. |
| `ui/collision-burst.png` | 512x512 | 1:1 | draft screen, when both players took the same item | The collision moment. This is the only information the draft leaks, so it should feel like an event. |

## VFX — 7 files

One per hook already wired into the resolve sequence. Each fires at a known beat in `src/ui/vfx/hooks.ts`; the placeholder animations are CSS and can be replaced one at a time.

| File | Size | Ratio | Where it appears | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vfx/hit-flare.webm` | 256x256 | 1:1 | a shot lands on a hull | hard orange-white bloom at the cell, brief screen-shake at the board level. Budget 520ms. Alpha channel required. A CSS animation stands in today. |
| `vfx/miss-splash.webm` | 256x256 | 1:1 | a shot lands on water | cool ring expanding outward, no light, no shake. Budget 520ms. Alpha channel required. A CSS animation stands in today. |
| `vfx/sink-sequence.webm` | 512x512 | 1:1 | a ship is announced sunk | the hull darkens along its length bow to stern, then the length number stamps over it. Budget 1400ms. Alpha channel required. A CSS animation stands in today. |
| `vfx/charge-accumulation.webm` | 256x256 | 1:1 | a charge seats on a card | the number swells and settles; the card edge picks up warmth as the count climbs. Budget 320ms. Alpha channel required. A CSS animation stands in today. |
| `vfx/charge-theft.webm` | 256x256 | 1:1 | Jam, Siphon, Leech or Blackout moves charges | charges arc across the gap between the two hands, arriving late enough to read. Budget 640ms. Alpha channel required. A CSS animation stands in today. |
| `vfx/ability-reveal-flip.webm` | 256x256 | 1:1 | an ACTIVE or NERF ability is activated | the ship card flips face up and stays up — identity revealed, position not. Budget 700ms. Alpha channel required. A CSS animation stands in today. |
| `vfx/prediction-trigger.webm` | 256x256 | 1:1 | Mirror or Ambush reads the opponent correctly | the named cell rings once and the incoming attack visibly stalls on it. Budget 900ms. Alpha channel required. A CSS animation stands in today. |

## Not needed

No music beds, no voice, no UI sound for ordinary taps, and no per-tier or
per-rank art variants — those are tints of one asset. Nothing here is a
placeholder for a decision that has not been made yet; if it is on the list, it
has a call site in the code today.
